Three languages

A salon in Paphos

Lilia Beauty & Spa is in Natalia Court on Iasonos, at the corner with Diagorou. Behind the reception is a deep green wall with the gold logo. Clients come for their nails, lashes and skin, and some of them come back every month.

What clients say

Three of 200 Google reviews, 186 of them with five stars.
